description.en:
Choose 15 cr.


YYou can include all AGE and ERE study track module courses in this study module, provided that you have not already selected them in other study track modules.

The thematic study track module can also include exchange courses, which must be approved by the study counsellor before the exchange period if they are to be included in the study track studies (the level and topic of the courses must be appropriate).


***********

M.Sc. level courses offered by the Helsinki Graduate School of Economics (see https://www.helsinkigse.fi/courses/) can be included to this study module. Recomended GSE-courses are in GSE-course section.

Courses can be added as cross-institutional studies.


See the instructions:

https://studies.helsinki.fi/instructions/article/sisu-instructions-applying-module-content-approval


Recommended courses:

  • ECON-E0900 Economics of energy markets
  • ECON-E800 Advanced Environmental Economics
  • 31E1500 Development economics I
  • 31E00500 International trade
  • ECON-E0200 Economics of cities

Other courses offered by the Helsinki Graduate School of Economics (GSE) are also suitable for the thematic study module.
